intent: A ridge-valkyrie's long courtly gown in cloud white, sky blue and warm rock tan: a slim white bodice over a tan steel-laced corset, a hooded short white cape and a long flared white skirt parted over a sky-blue underskirt, reading from the high camera as a narrow pale top over a wide white bell.
requests: A tapered or cone part for skirts and sleeves, so a gown flares smoothly from hip to ankle and an upper arm can narrow below the shoulder.
